question: What is the new system launched by the Delhi Chief Minister at ITO for pollution and dust control?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pole-mounted mist spray system.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Delhi CM Rekha Gupta launched a pole-mounted mist spray system at ITO to combat dust and air pollution in the capital.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The new system is a pole-mounted mist spray mechanism installed initially at ITO.**
 
• **35 poles equipped currently; plan to expand to 305 poles across 9 pollution hotspots.**
 
• **Each pole has 5 nozzles with 6 holes each, giving 30 spray points per pole.**
 
• **Uses treated water (approx. 84 litres per hour per pole) for dust suppression.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Mist Spray System**__

 __
 
• Designed to reduce dust particles and improve air quality.
 
• Operates automatically with treated water sprayers on roadside poles.
 
• Earlier trialed under NDMC areas with positive results.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure Scale**__
 __
 
• Supported by four 5,000-litre storage tanks near ITO.
 
• Also installed along 900m stretch of Shanti Path and 500m at Lodhi Road.
 
 
 
• **Delhi Pollution Control Drive**__
 __
 
• Strict actions to be taken against agencies showing negligence in pollution control.
 
• DPCC empowered for challans and penalties; FIRs for unauthorized road-cutting.
 
• 311 Green App strengthened for reporting dust hotspots and potholes.
 
 
 
• **Objective**__
 
 
• Immediate reduction of dust — a major contributor to PM2.5 & PM10.
 
• Part of a larger emergency pollution mission by the Delhi government.
